author: praasz
title: LLM accuracy GPU test fails — Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8 metric drop exceeds threshold

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: AssertionError: Metric drop 0.05254477262496948 exceeds threshold 0.03 for Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU

key_errors: FAILED tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py::test_accuracy_conformance[Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU] - AssertionError: Metric drop 0.05254477262496948 exceeds threshold 0.03
root_cause: The LLM accuracy conformance test for Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct (INT8, GPU) measured a metric drop of ~0.0525, exceeding the allowed threshold of 0.03. This test evaluates model accuracy on iGPU hardware and is sensitive to hardware state, driver versions, and non-deterministic GPU execution. The PR under test (PR #37611) modifies only IR FE XML deserialization code (src/core/xml_util/src/xml_deserialize_util.cpp and frontend tests), which is entirely unrelated to GPU inference or quantization accuracy. The accuracy failure is not caused by the PR change — it is a hardware-sensitive, non-deterministic accuracy measurement that has failed on an unrelated merge-queue run.
reproduction_steps: N/A — accuracy measurements on GPU hardware are environment-sensitive and not reproducible in a standard dev environment.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job — the accuracy metric is non-deterministic and may pass on retry
Investigate whether the Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8 accuracy threshold (0.03) is set too tightly for this GPU configuration
Check recent GPU driver updates or hardware configuration changes on the CI runner that may affect accuracy measurements
prevention_strategies: Accuracy thresholds for LLM models on GPU should be calibrated with sufficient margin to account for non-determinism. Consider widening thresholds or adding test retries for accuracy conformance tests.
historical_context: No prior records of this specific accuracy failure pattern in the investigation database. This is the first occurrence.
